clue.text: Well-organised, move up bound by rope?

indicators.note: bound by means held within, so the rope encloses the other piece

parts.note: a tether is a rope that ties an animal

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to go is to move

explanation.surface: A climber asks whether a team roped together is well organised as it moves up.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' reads the move backwards; 'bound by' sets it within the rope. 'Well-organised' is the informal 'got it together'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with it all together is organised and composed, an informal sense.

clue.text: Personal motif groomsman designed, ignoring last of names

indicators.note: designed suggests the letters are shaped into a new pattern
ignoring tells us to leave a letter out of the fodder
last of picks the final letter of the word names

explanation.surface: A wedding helper designs a personal emblem but leaves off part of the names.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignoring last of names' drops the S from GROOMSMAN, leaving GROOMMAN, which 'designed' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A monogram is a design of interwoven initials used as a personal emblem.

clue.text: Despite everything, look at fewer

parts.note: to regard something is to look at it
less is used loosely for fewer

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to study fewer things whatever happens.
explanation.definitionFit: Regardless as an adverb means in spite of everything, without heeding circumstances.

clue.text: Queen's troubled reign before onset of anarchy

indicators.note: troubled suggests the letters are disturbed into a new order
onset of picks the first letter of the word anarchy

explanation.surface: A queen's turbulent rule comes just before the realm falls into anarchy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'troubled' turns REIGN into REGIN; 'onset of anarchy' adds A. The 's is short for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Regina is Latin for queen, used in the title of a reigning British monarch.

clue.text: Deny remark disregarded profit

indicators.note: disregarded means the second word is ignored and taken away

parts.note: to gainsay is to deny or contradict
to say something is to remark

explanation.surface: Someone denies that a remark ignored the profit involved.
explanation.definitionFit: A gain is a profit or benefit acquired.

clue.text: Notorious Russian artist's inserted

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist; with the 's it gives RA'S
put in means inserted

explanation.surface: A painter's work has been placed into an exhibition of a notorious Russian.
explanation.definitionFit: Rasputin was the infamous mystic who held sway over the last Tsar's family.

clue.text: Place and time to find destructive insect

parts.note: a locus is a place or position

explanation.surface: A naturalist notes where and when to spot a crop-eating pest.
explanation.definitionFit: Locusts swarm in vast numbers and strip crops bare.

clue.text: Regret, likewise, start of rancorous dispute

parts.note: so means likewise, as in 'so do I'

indicators.note: start of picks the first letter of the word rancorous

parts.note: a row is a dispute or quarrel

explanation.surface: Two people both regret the beginning of a bitter quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorrow and regret are both feelings of sadness over what has happened.

clue.text: Aquatic bird gripping tail of grey European wolf

indicators.note: gripping means holding something inside

parts.note: a coot is a water bird

indicators.note: tail of picks the last letter of the word grey

explanation.surface: A water bird clutches the tail of a grey European wolf.
explanation.definitionFit: The coyote is a small North American wild dog, also called the prairie wolf.

clue.text: Unsafe, cover across middle of deck

indicators.note: across means one piece stretches over the other, enclosing it

parts.note: to insure is to provide cover

indicators.note: middle of picks the central letters of the word deck

explanation.surface: A sailor finds the covering over the middle of the deck unsafe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cover' is insurance, not a tarpaulin; 'across' means the cover spans the middle letters of 'deck'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something insecure is not firmly fixed and so not safe.

clue.text: Downgrading of French movement

parts.note: de is French for of
motion means movement

explanation.surface: A report on the downgrading of a French political movement.
explanation.definitionFit: A demotion is a reduction in rank or status.

clue.text: On horseback, photograph outcome

parts.note: a rider who is up is mounted on a horse
a shot is a photograph

explanation.surface: A jockey's photo in the saddle shows the race result.
explanation.definitionFit: The upshot is the final result or consequence of something.

clue.text: Apothecary in 'Paris Match' spread

indicators.note: spread suggests the letters are laid out afresh, as in a magazine spread

explanation.surface: A chemist features in a double-page spread in the French magazine Paris Match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spread' doubles as a magazine feature, which hides its job as the rearranging signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An apothecary is the old term for someone who prepares and sells medicines.

clue.text: Suffer at work with endless smoke

parts.note: in can mean at work, as in 'in the office'

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: to cure fish or meat is to smoke it

explanation.surface: Someone suffers in the office alongside a never-ending cigarette.
explanation.definitionFit: To incur a loss or penalty is to suffer or bring it upon oneself.

clue.text: Small charge for zapper

parts.note: remote means slight or small, as in a remote chance
having charge of something is having control of it

explanation.surface: A shop asks a small fee for a TV zapper.
explanation.definitionFit: Zapper is informal for the handset used to change television channels.

clue.text: What players may be showing form on pitch?

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: a type is a form or kind
to cast is to pitch or throw

explanation.surface: Footballers showing their usual form on the pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Actors who are typecast keep being given the same kind of role.

clue.text: Gambling game allowed during course

indicators.note: during means within the span of, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: a route is a course taken
let means allowed

explanation.surface: Gambling is permitted during the course of a cruise.
explanation.definitionFit: Roulette is a casino game played on a spinning wheel.

clue.text: Student deserving scholarship

parts.note: L is a learner, a student driver
earning means deserving, as in earning praise

explanation.surface: A student who merits a funded place at college.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scholarship' is not a grant here but the knowledge itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Scholarship as knowledge gained by study is another word for erudition.

clue.text: House harbouring a bad-tempered person

indicators.note: harbouring means sheltering something inside

parts.note: Virgo is one of the twelve astrological houses or signs

explanation.surface: A household gives shelter to an irritable lodger.
explanation.definitionFit: A virago is a domineering, ill-tempered woman.

clue.text: Exploding firework's colour

definitions.meaning: a loud rocket-type firework, also used as a distress signal

explanation.surface: The colour of a firework as it explodes.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a flare that bangs and a deep red-brown shade.

clue.text: Specific item

definitions.meaning: noun for a single detail, as in 'in every respect'

explanation.surface: A specific item.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an adjective meaning precise and a noun for a single detail.

clue.text: One king upset about southern state

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so these letters wrap round another

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means the word is turned upside down

parts.note: Lear is Shakespeare's king

explanation.surface: A single monarch is overthrown over a southern state.
explanation.walkthrough: The king is Shakespeare's Lear; 'upset' turns him over in this down clue, and 'about' wraps one plus that round the S.
explanation.definitionFit: Israel is a country in the Middle East.

clue.text: Plagiarist may make head of publishing furious

indicators.note: head of picks the first letter of the word publishing

parts.note: irate means furious

explanation.surface: A copycat writer might enrage the chief of a publishing house.
explanation.definitionFit: Pirate describes someone who copies others' work without permission.

clue.text: An opening for tailor after worsted fabric, one with stripes

indicators.note: after means these letters come after the fabric piece

parts.note: serge is a hard-wearing worsted cloth

indicators.note: opening for picks the first letter of the word tailor

explanation.surface: A tailor sees a business opening in worsted cloth for uniforms.
explanation.definitionFit: A sergeant wears chevrons, the stripes on the sleeve showing rank.

clue.text: Head of society, mature and wise

indicators.note: head of picks the first letter of the word society

parts.note: to age is to mature

explanation.surface: The leader of a society is grown-up and wise.
explanation.definitionFit: Sage as an adjective means wise and judicious.

clue.text: View of other ranks in country

indicators.note: in means placed inside the next piece

parts.note: Panama is a Central American country
OR stands for other ranks, soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: The opinion of the ordinary soldiers in a country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'View' looks like an opinion but is a wide outlook.
explanation.definitionFit: A panorama is a wide unbroken view of a landscape.

clue.text: Former nurse's offer

parts.note: ex means former
to tend is to nurse

explanation.surface: An ex-nurse makes a proposal.
explanation.definitionFit: To extend a welcome or invitation is to offer it.

clue.text: Shabbily dressed, in blue floppy hat, slippery character

parts.note: down means blue, sad

indicators.note: floppy suggests the letters flop into a new order

parts.note: an eel is slippery, so a slippery character

explanation.surface: A shabby figure in a sad floppy hat, a slippery sort.
explanation.definitionFit: Down at heel describes someone looking poor and shabby, from worn shoe heels.
